thread:
maya.support: Heads up — ACME reported inconsistent embedding vector lengths across deployments. Hosted responses are 1536 dims, Dedicated returns 768. Happened since yesterday afternoon. req_id: r-83a2. Anyone seen this?

devon-ml: Yikes. Do we have the exact request payload + model param? Can you paste a minimal repro?

maya.support: Sure, here's the request they sent (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "text-embedding-3-large",
  "input": ["Revenue forecast Q2"],
  "deployment": "dedicated-1"
}
```
They also tried same request against hosted API and got a 1536 vector. Dedicated returned 768 without error (so downstream stores then error when expecting 1536).

embed-checker-bot: Automated alert: embed-compare job "embed-crossenv-v1" flagged dim mismatch for req r-83a2. env.hosted=1536 env.dedicated=768

kurt.sre: Possible causes: 1) Dedicated is routing to a quantized variant that halves dims, 2) model alias mapping changed, or 3) fallback to a smaller model under load. Check model_alias and fallback logs.

elena.ops: Quick lookup: dedicated-1 currently maps to "text-embed-q4_0_8bit" in catalog (768 dims). Hosted points at "text-embedding-3-large" (1536). Looks like catalog sync rolled an alias change yesterday during model-catalog deploy.

devon-ml: Confirmed cause hypothesis. Repro steps for support/dev to validate:
1) curl against hosted with explicit model header: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":"Revenue forecast Q2"}'
```
2) curl against dedicated endpoint without pinning to see routing:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated-1.redwood.internal/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEDICATED_KEY" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-large","input":"Revenue forecast Q2"}'
```
3) If dims differ, try forcing variant pin: add header `X-Redwood-Pin-Model: text-embedding-3-large` and compare.

maya.support: Customer also saw intermittent 400 downstream errors when indexing vectors (vector-store rejected dims). They reported retries and a billing spike from repeated retries + fallback attempts.

elena.ops: For immediate mitigation I applied a routing override for org acme-corp to force hosted model for embeddings. That should stop parity failures while we fix the catalog. Monitoring now.

kurt.sre: I'll pull smart-routing logs for yesterday 18:05-18:40 to confirm if fallback triggered. If fallback policy allowed downgrade to q4 quantized, that's the bug. We should also ensure fallback variants preserve dimensionality.

devon-ml: Long-term fix: add validation rule to model-catalog deploy that rejects alias changes that change output shape for the same logical model id, and add CI check that runs quick embedding shape probe per variant. I'll open INFRA-4297.

maya.support: Thanks — can you also confirm the billing regen? They want an explanation and possible credit. Ticket #12345.

elena.ops: I'll pull org-level usage and retry counts; looks like ~12 retries in their window. Tagging finance & billing for possible credit path.

kurt.sre: Action items: I will check logs + fallback traces.

devon-ml: I will update catalog validation + open a PR to block shape-changing alias swaps.

elena.ops: I will keep the routing override until we push the fix and coordinate a safe catalog rollback.

maya.support: Great. Please post updates here and ping me when we have a rollback or a formal customer response. Customer is on a call at 14:00 PT. :pray:

-- ACTIONS --
- devon-ml: open INFRA-4297 for catalog validation (ETA EOD).
- kurt.sre: investigate smart-routing fallback traces (ETA 2h).
- elena.ops: maintain temporary routing override for acme-corp + gather retry/usage logs (ETA 1h).
- maya.support: prepare customer update and provisional remediation note.
